# CANDIDATE: ORB_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A break below the opening-range low on elevated volume with a bearish close signals short-term continuation due to trapped longs and fresh selling pressure. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend the opening range, and a decisive break on volume indicates genuine supply-demand imbalance rather than noise.

## Mechanism

Compute average 5-minute volume within the first 30-minute opening range (OR). Enter short on the first 5-minute bar that: (1) closes below OR low, (2) has close in lower 30% of its bar range (bearish body), and (3) volume > 1.5× average OR volume. Stop at OR high (chart-stop). Target: exit at 1×ATR entry or when price crosses back above VWAP (mean-reversion). Only active when VIX > 18 and OR width < 0.2% of SPY price (tight range compression).
